items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: Claude Jones, that's it, yeah. Claude was very -- marvelous trombone player... But they would put me on... these guys were so full of fun... I was like a youngster in the band

ctx.x: Was the trombone player Claude Jones?

Claude Jones, that's it, yeah. Claude was very -- marvelous trombone player, marvelous person. But they would put me on, they would -- as I say they would fight and they would pretend that they were going to attack Fletcher, sometimes, and I'm trying to get -- keep them from going -- don't do that to Fletcher, Fletcher's such a marvelous --
and Fletcher was. Fletcher reminded me a lot of Duke, and --
